title: Nine Klein LoRA mirrors 404 - the release dep gate is red for all of them
description: Found 2026-09-01 by MPI-679's verification run, and pre-existing on master. `npm run release:deps` reports NINE dead mirrors besides the foley one: klein-9b-lora-nsfw plus all eight 4B Klein style LoRAs (muppets, cartoon, anime, jojo, chibi, doodle, vintage, aesthetic). Every primary is healthy on R2; every `[mirror]` is a 404 at the generic HF prefix rewrite path under Mad-Pony-Interactive/cubric-studio - the weights were never pushed there. Effect: nine deps on a single route, the regression MPI-429's mirror system exists to prevent, and the release gate exits 1 for all of them. These are NOT the same decision MPI-679 made: they are CivitAI-sourced community LoRAs, and loraDeps.js already documents klein-9b-lora-nsfw as deliberately mirror-less (CivitAI region-blocks the UK) - it is simply missing the `noMirror: true` flag that would say so, which is why the rewrite emits a URL that can only 404. Per dep, decide: re-host to our HF repo where the CivitAI flags allow redistribution (licence table: docs/models/klein/licences.md), or set `noMirror: true` WITH a reason comment. Either way release:deps must end at 0 UNREACHABLE, because a permanently-red release gate teaches everyone to ignore it.
